definitions.gloss: sharp tongue, caustic remarks, biting speech
definitions.explanation: Harsh, cutting, or sarcastic speech that criticizes others. Can refer both to the tendency to speak sharply and to the remarks themselves. In entertainment contexts, it can have an admiring or humorous tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: That teacher is famous for having a sharp tongue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: His caustic remarks are funny, but some people get hurt.

examples.japanese: {毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦バラエティ→バラエティ：11398_baraeti⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Entertainers popular for their sharp-tongued persona are thriving on variety shows.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "poison tongue." Can be used as a noun ({毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ = to make caustic remarks) or as a modifier ({毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧ = sharp-tongued character/persona). In Japanese entertainment, {毒舌|どくぜつ} is often seen as an entertaining quality, and certain comedians and TV personalities are known for their {毒舌|どくぜつ} style.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to make caustic remarks
- {毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧: sharp-tongued persona
- {毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: person known for sharp remarks
- {毒舌|どくぜつ}⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧: sharp-tongued comedian

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皮肉|ひにく}→皮肉：00103_hiniku⟧: sarcasm, irony (more indirect and intellectual)
- ⟦{辛口|からくち}→辛口：18794_karakuchi⟧: harsh criticism, blunt (originally describes dry sake/wine taste)
